name: @activepieces/piece-bokio
description: Bokio is an accounting software platform which offers digital bookkeeping, invoicing, and financial management tools to help simplify accounting processes.

auth.description: Bokio API Key is required to authenticate requests to Bokio

createCustomer.name: createCustomer
createCustomer.description: Creates a new customer in Bokio

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms for the customer. Payment terms for the invoices. Payment terms can both take free text or days, in digits, until the payment is due.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new customer record in a Bokio accounting company. Use to register a person or company before invoicing them; only customer name and type (individual/company) are required, with optional VAT/org number, contact, and address details. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate customer.

createInvoice.name: createInvoice
createInvoice.description: Creates a new draft invoice in Bokio

orderNumberReference.description: The order number associated with the invoice

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., SEK, EUR, USD)

auth.description: Bokio API Key is required to authenticate requests to Bokio

dynamicProps.description: Configure item details based on item type

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new draft invoice in a Bokio company with a single line item. Use to start a new customer invoice; invoice date, due date, and item type are required, and the customer is linked by passing the customer UUID. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate draft invoice.

addLineItemToInvoice.name: addLineItemToInvoice
addLineItemToInvoice.description: Adds a line item to an existing draft invoice

auth.description: Bokio API Key is required to authenticate requests to Bokio
Bokio API Key is required to authenticate requests to Bokio

dynamicProps.description: Configure item details based on item type

aiMetadata.description: Appends a single line item to an existing draft invoice in Bokio, identified by invoice ID. Use to add a product, service, or description-only row to an invoice that already exists; pricing fields apply only when item type is a sales item. Not idempotent — each call appends another line item.

createAnItem.name: createAnItem
createAnItem.description: Creates a new item in Bokio

auth.description: Bokio API Key is required to authenticate requests to Bokio

dynamicProps.description: Configure item details based on item type

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new reusable item (a sales item with pricing, or a text item) in a Bokio company catalog. Use to define a product or service that can later be referenced on invoices; item type is required. Not idempotent — each call creates a separate item.

createAJournalEntry.name: createAJournalEntry
createAJournalEntry.description: Creates a new journal entry in Bokio

items.description: Journal entry items as JSON array. Each item should have: account (account number), debit (optional), credit (optional)

account.description: Account number for the journal entry item

debit.description: Debit amount for the journal entry item

credit.description: Credit amount for the journal entry item

aiMetadata.description: Records a new bookkeeping journal entry in a Bokio company, posting debit/credit amounts against account numbers. Use for manual double-entry transactions; the entry date is required and items carry the per-account debit/credit lines. Not idempotent — each call posts a separate journal entry.

updateAnInvoice.name: updateAnInvoice
updateAnInvoice.description: Updates an existing draft invoice in Bokio

auth.description: Bokio API Key is required to authenticate requests to Bokio

orderNumberReference.description: The order number associated with the invoice

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., SEK, EUR, USD)

lineItemsJson.description: Line items as JSON array. Each item should have: itemRef (object with id), description, quantity, unitPrice, unit, itemType (PRODUCT or SERVICE), vat

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing draft invoice in Bokio, identified by invoice ID, replacing fields such as type, customer, dates, currency, and the full line-items list (passed as a JSON array). Use to modify an invoice that already exists rather than create one. Idempotent — repeating the same update yields the same invoice state.

findCustomer.name: findCustomer
findCustomer.description: Find customers in Bokio by filtering and pagination

pageSize.description: Number of items per page (max 100, defaults to 25)

aiMetadata.description: Lists customers in a Bokio company with pagination, optionally filtered by name, type, VAT number, or organization number. Leaving the filter empty returns all customers; supplying a filter type and value narrows to matching records. Use to look up a customer or their ID. Idempotent read-only lookup.

getDraftInvoiceByCustomerName.name: getDraftInvoiceByCustomerName
getDraftInvoiceByCustomerName.displayName: Get Draft Invoice by Customer Name
getDraftInvoiceByCustomerName.description: Get all draft invoices for a customer by customer name

customerName.description: Name of the customer to find draft invoices for

pageSize.description: Number of items per page (max 100, defaults to 25)

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a Bokio customer by exact name and returns their draft invoices with pagination. Use when you have a customer name (not an ID) and want their pending draft invoices; returns an empty result if no customer matches. Idempotent read-only lookup.

getAnInvoice.name: getAnInvoice
getAnInvoice.description: Retrieve a specific invoice by its ID

invoiceId.description: The ID of the invoice to retrieve

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a single invoice from a Bokio company by its invoice ID. Use when you already have the invoice ID and need its full details. Idempotent read-only lookup.

getAJournalEntry.name: getAJournalEntry
getAJournalEntry.description: Retrieve a specific journal entry by its ID

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a single journal entry from a Bokio company by its UUID. Use when you already have the journal entry ID and need its full bookkeeping details. Idempotent read-only lookup.

custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
